name: Reverse Mortgage Calculator
meta_description: Estimate a HECM reverse mortgage for 2026: principal limit, upfront and annual mortgage insurance, cash or monthly payments, and how the loan balance grows.
subtitle: Estimate how much you could receive from an FHA-insured reverse mortgage (HECM) after fees and any existing mortgage, and how the loan balance and your equity change over time.

2026 HECM rules: home value counted up to $1,249,125, 2% upfront and 0.5% annual mortgage insurance. Estimates only — a HECM lender and a HUD-approved counselor will give you exact figures. You must keep paying property tax, insurance and upkeep.
